oven_model unique:',sorted(mes.oven_model.dropna().unique().tolist())) print('board_family unique:',sorted(mes.board_family.dropna().unique().tolist())) print('tc_location unique:',sorted(tc.tc_location.dropna().unique().tolist()))  cov=mes[['run_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(tc[['run_id']].drop_duplicates(), on='run_id', how='left', indicator=True) print('

Compute Q01-Q05 metrics from handbook, MES, defects, thermocouples and write JSON: $ /app/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY' import json import math from pathlib import Path import pandas as pd  out_dir=Path('/app/output') out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  mes=pd.read_csv('/app/data/mes_log.csv') tc=pd.read_csv('/app/data/thermocouples.csv') defects=pd.read_csv('/app/data/test_defects.csv')  # Handbook-derived constants (page 5 and page 14) RAMP_RATE_LIMIT_C_PER_S=2.0  # "minimize the rate of rise to less than 2°C/second" PREHEAT_MAX_TEMP_C=150.0     # "preheat ... to temperatures generally between 100°C to 150°C" PEAK_MARGIN_ABOVE_LIQUIDUS_C=20.0  # "must be exceeded by approximately 20°C to ensure quality reflow" TAL_MIN_S=30.0  # "wetting time is normally 30 to 60 seconds" TAL_MAX_S=60.0  mes['run_id']=mes['run_id'].astype(str) tc['run_id']=tc['run_id'].astype(str) defects['run_id']=defects['run_id'].astype(str)  # Ensure numeric columns for col in ['time_s','temp_c']:     tc[col]=pd.to_numeric(tc[col], errors='coerce')  # ---------- Q01: max preheat ramp by run ----------  tc_sorted=tc.sort_values(['run_id','tc_id','time_s']).copy() # compute next values within each run/tc for c in ['time_s','temp_c']:     tc_sorted[c+'_next']=tc_sorted.groupby(['run_id','tc_id'])[c].shift(-1)  tc_sorted['dt']=tc_sorted['time_s_next']-tc_sorted['time_s'] tc_sorted['dtemp']=tc_sorted['temp_c_next']-tc_sorted['temp_c']  preheat_mask=(tc_sorted['dt']>0) & (tc_sorted['temp_c'].notna()) & (tc_sorted['temp_c_next'].notna()) & (tc_sorted['temp_c']<=PREHEAT_MAX_TEMP_C) & (tc_sorted['temp_c_next']<=PREHEAT_MAX_TEMP_C)  tc_sorted.loc[preheat_mask,'ramp_c_per_s']=tc_sorted.loc[preheat_mask,'dtemp']/tc_sorted.loc[preheat_mask,'dt']  ramp_by_run_tc=(     tc_sorted.loc[preheat_mask]     .groupby(['run_id','tc_id'], as_index=False)['ramp_c_per_s']     .max() )  # pick worst-case (maximum ramp) tc per run ramp_pick=(     ramp_by_run_tc.sort_values(['run_id','ramp_c_per_s','tc_id'], ascending=[True,False,True])     .groupby('run_id', as_index=False)     .first() )  max_ramp_by_run={} violating=[] for _,row in ramp_pick.sort_values('run_id').iterrows():     run=row['run_id']     val=row['ramp_c_per_s']     tc_id=row['tc_id']     # round to 2 decimals     max_ramp_by_run[run]={         'tc_id': tc_id if pd.notna(tc_id) else None,         'max_preheat_ramp_c_per_s': (round(float(val),2) if pd.notna(val) else None)     }     if pd.notna(val) and float(val)>RAMP_RATE_LIMIT_C_PER_S:         violating.append(run)  q01={     'ramp_rate_limit_c_per_s': round(RAMP_RATE_LIMIT_C_PER_S,2),     'violating_runs': sorted(violating),     'max_ramp_by_run': max_ramp_by_run }  (out_dir/'q01.json').write_text(json.dumps(q01, indent=2, sort_keys=False))  # ---------- Q02: TAL by run (representative TC = minimum TAL / coldest joint) ----------  mes_liq=mes[['run_id','solder_liquidus_c']].copy() mes_liq['solder_liquidus_c']=pd.to_numeric(mes_liq['solder_liquidus_c'], errors='coerce')  # Merge liquidus into thermocouple rows work=tc_sorted[['run_id','tc_id','time_s','temp_c']].merge(mes_liq, on='run_id', how='left')   def tal_for_group(g: pd.DataFrame) -> float|None:     L=g['solder_liquidus_c'].iloc[0]     if pd.isna(L):         return None     g=g[['time_s','temp_c']].dropna().sort_values('time_s')     if len(g)<2:         return None     t=g['time_s'].to_numpy()     y=g['temp_c'].to_numpy()     tal=0.0     for i in range(len(t)-1):         t0,t1=t[i],t[i+1]         y0,y1=y[i],y[i+1]         if not (math.isfinite(t0) and math.isfinite(t1) and math.isfinite(y0) and math.isfinite(y1)):             continue         if t1<=t0:             continue         above0=y0>L         above1=y1>L         if above0 and above1:             tal += (t1-t0)         elif (not above0) and (not above1):             continue         else:             # crossing; linear interpolation             if y1==y0:                 continue             frac=(L-y0)/(y1-y0)             if frac<0 or frac>1:                 continue             tcross=t0 + frac*(t1-t0)             if (not above0) and above1:                 tal += (t1-tcross)             elif above0 and (not above1):                 tal += (tcross-t0)     return tal  # compute TAL per run/tc rows=[] for (run,tc_id),g in work.groupby(['run_id','tc_id']):     tal=tal_for_group(g)     rows.append((run,tc_id,tal))  tal_df=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['run_id','tc_id','tal_s'])  # select minimum TAL per run rep_tal=(     tal_df.sort_values(['run_id','tal_s','tc_id'], ascending=[True,True,True])     .groupby('run_id', as_index=False)     .first()     .merge(mes_liq, on='run_id', how='left') )  q02=[] for _,r in rep_tal.sort_values('run_id').iterrows():     tal=r['tal_s']     status='non-compliant'     if pd.notna(tal) and (tal>=TAL_MIN_S) and (tal<=TAL_MAX_S):         status='compliant'     q02.append({         'run_id': r['run_id'],         'tc_id': r['tc_id'] if pd.notna(r['tc_id']) else None,         'tal_s': (round(float(tal),2) if pd.notna(tal) else None),         'required_min_tal_s': round(TAL_MIN_S,2),         'required_max_tal_s': round(TAL_MAX_S,2),         'status': status,     })  (out_dir/'q02.json').write_text(json.dumps(q02, indent=2, sort_keys=False))  # ---------- Q03: peak temperature requirement ----------  peak_by_run_tc=(tc.groupby(['run_id','tc_id'], as_index=False)['temp_c'].max().rename(columns={'temp_c':'peak_temp_c'}))  # select minimum peak per run (coldest point) min_peak=(     peak_by_run_tc.sort_values(['run_id','peak_temp_c','tc_id'], ascending=[True,True,True])     .groupby('run_id', as_index=False)     .first()     .merge(mes_liq, on='run_id', how='left') )  min_peak_by_run={} failing=[] for _,r in min_peak.sort_values('run_id').iterrows():     run=r['run_id']     liq=r['solder_liquidus_c']     req=None     if pd.notna(liq):         req=float(liq)+PEAK_MARGIN_ABOVE_LIQUIDUS_C     peak=r['peak_temp_c']     if (req is None) or pd.isna(peak) or (float(peak) < req):         failing.append(run)     min_peak_by_run[run]={         'tc_id': r['tc_id'] if pd.notna(r['tc_id']) else None,         'peak_temp_c': (round(float(peak),2) if pd.notna(peak) else None),         'required_min_peak_c': (round(float(req),2) if req is not None else None)     }  q03={     'failing_runs': sorted(failing),     'min_peak_by_run': min_peak_by_run }  (out_dir/'q03.json').write_text(json.dumps(q03, indent=2, sort_keys=False))  # ---------- Q04: conveyor speed feasibility ----------  mes_num=mes.copy() for col in ['boards_per_min','board_length_cm','loading_factor','conveyor_speed_cm_min','downtime_s']:     if col in mes_num.columns:         mes_num[col]=pd.to_numeric(mes_num[col], errors='coerce')  mes_num['required_min_speed_cm_min']=mes_num['boards_per_min']*mes_num['board_length_cm']/mes_num['loading_factor']  q04=[] for _,r in mes_num.sort_values('run_id').iterrows():     req=r['required_min_speed_cm_min']     act=r['conveyor_speed_cm_min']     meets=bool(pd.notna(req) and pd.notna(act) and float(act)>=float(req))     q04.append({         'run_id': r['run_id'],         'required_min_speed_cm_min': (round(float(req),2) if pd.notna(req) else None),         'actual_speed_cm_min': (round(float(act),2) if pd.notna(act) else None),         'meets': meets     })  (out_dir/'q04.json').write_text(json.dumps(q04, indent=2, sort_keys=False))  # ---------- Q05: best run per board_family based on quality + efficiency ----------  # defect summary fp_yield_pct (prefer SUMMARY row) summary=defects[(defects['inspection_stage']=='SUMMARY') & (defects['defect_type']=='yield_summary')].copy() for c in ['fp_yield_pct','units_tested','units_pass','units_rework','units_scrap']:     if c in summary.columns:         summary[c]=pd.to_numeric(summary[c], errors='coerce')  summary=summary[['run_id','fp_yield_pct','units_tested','units_pass','units_rework','units_scrap']].drop_duplicates('run_id')  runs=mes_num[['run_id','board_family','boards_per_min','downtime_s','conveyor_speed_cm_min','required_min_speed_cm_min']].merge(summary, on='run_id', how='left')  # attach compliance ramp_ok=set([run for run,val in ((k,v['max_preheat_ramp_c_per_s']) for k,v in max_ramp_by_run.items()) if (val is not None and val<=RAMP_RATE_LIMIT_C_PER_S)])  # TAL ok based on selected representative (min TAL) tal_ok=set([d['run_id'] for d in q02 if d['tal_s'] is not None and (d['tal_s']>=TAL_MIN_S and d['tal_s']<=TAL_MAX_S)])  # Peak ok peak_ok=set([run for run in min_peak_by_run if run not in failing])  # Speed ok speed_ok=set([d['run_id'] for d in q04 if d['meets']])  runs['compliant_all']=runs['run_id'].apply(lambda x: (x in ramp_ok and x in tal_ok and x in peak_ok and x in speed_ok))  # quality score: fp_yield_pct else units_pass/units_tested runs['quality_score']=runs['fp_yield_pct'] mask_missing=runs['quality_score'].isna() & runs['units_pass'].notna() & runs['units_tested'].notna() & (runs['units_tested']!=0) runs.loc[mask_missing,'quality_score']=runs.loc[mask_missing,'units_pass']/runs.loc[mask_missing,'units_tested']*100.0 runs['quality_score']=runs['quality_score'].fillna(0.0)  runs['efficiency_score']=runs['boards_per_min'].fillna(0.0)  q05=[] for fam,g in runs.groupby('board_family'):     g=g.copy()     # sort: compliant first, then quality desc, efficiency desc, downtime asc, run_id asc     g=g.sort_values(         by=['compliant_all','quality_score','efficiency_score','downtime_s','run_id'],         ascending=[False,False,False,True,True]     )     best=g.iloc[0]['run_id'] if len(g)>0 else None     runner=[r for r in g['run_id'].tolist() if r!=best]     q05.append({         'board_family': fam,         'best_run_id': best,         'runner_up_run_ids': sorted(runner)     })  q05=sorted(q05, key=lambda d: (d['board_family'] or '')) (out_dir/'q05.json').write_text(json.dumps(q05, indent=2, sort_keys=False))  print('Wrote:',*(str(p) for p in sorted(out_dir.glob('q0*.json'))), sep='\n - ') PY

Validate output JSONs contain all runs and expected keys: $ /app/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY' import json from pathlib import Path q01=json.loads(Path('/app/output/q01.json').read_text()) q02=json.loads(Path('/app/output/q02.json').read_text()) q03=json.loads(Path('/app/output/q03.json').read_text()) q04=json.loads(Path('/app/output/q04.json').read_text()) q05=json.loads(Path('/app/output/q05.json').read_text()) print('q01 runs',len(q01['max_ramp_by_run'])) print('q02 rows',len(q02)) print('q03 runs',len(q03['min_peak_by_run'])) print('q04 rows',len(q04)) print('q05 rows',len(q05)) # spot check ordering print('q02 first/last',q02[0]['run_id'],q02[-1]['run_id']) print('q04 first/last',q04[0]['run_id'],q04[-1]['run_id']) print('q05 families', [d['board_family'] for d in q05]) PY
